name: Flamingo Cycle
description: One-foot balance cycle that lifts either leg on command and returns to a two-foot stand.
details: A single policy shifts onto the selected foot, lifts the other roughly 9 cm, holds the pose, and lowers it again. The command uses twist = [flag, side, 0], where flag selects one-foot mode and side selects the supporting foot. The publisher reports 20 held and 2 stepped-down recoveries in 24 random simulation trials; it has never been tested on hardware.

verification.summary: Public simulation-only one-foot balance export; no physical Microduck deployment evidence is documented.
verification.notes: The publisher documents backward-push failure limits and step-down recovery in simulation. Use flag = 0 to return to a two-foot stand.

contract.actuator_model: Dynamixel XL330 (BAM M6 voltage control law)

simulation.notes: Uses the publisher-defined twist = [flag, side, 0] balance command rather than the registry velocity schedule.
